item.title: Froma Harrop: If you want to be ‘seen,’ try seeing others
item.description: I recently came across a curious headline: “The Retirement Crisis No One Warns You About: Mattering.” Very few people leaving the workplace have prepared for losing a big part of their identity, according to the Wall Street Journal article. They long to “feel seen” in the next chapter of life. The post Froma Harrop: If you want to be ‘seen,’ try seeing others appeared first on The Dispatch.
